title: Inorder Successor in BST II

examples.explanation: 1's in-order successor node is 2. Note that both the node and the return value is of Node type.
There is no in-order successor of the current node, so the answer is null.

constraints: The number of nodes in the tree is in the range [1, 10^4].
All Nodes will have unique values.
hints: Analyze the constraints and data structures appropriate for Inorder Successor in BST II.
Formulate an optimal state transition or traversal invariant.
Consider corner testcases and boundary limits.
